_comment: v1.11 Bridge Phase A — v1.10 Cryptex performance baseline anchor.
Captured from the v1.10 baseline code (tag v1.10 = commit 07f0126).
The measurement was taken at repo HEAD 6153fa3, which is a doc-only
commit (adds docs/internal/v1.11_bridge_build_plan.md) on top of
07f0126 and is therefore byte-identical to v1.10 for all compiled
translation units — so these numbers are the v1.10 anchor.
Methodology (plan v1.11 §6.3, inherited from v1.10 §10.6.6):
- binary: build/tests/fceux11_bench_tolerance_test.exe
- run from tests/ (fixtures/ + baseline json resolve relative to cwd)
- per round: 3 warm-up passes + 7 timed iterations, drop min+max,
median of remaining 5 (bench_tolerance_test R4 default)
- best-of-3: 3 sequential rounds, take the minimum (best) round median
- sequential execution (no parallel rounds; avoids CPU contention)
Raw per-round medians (ms for 60 frames):
Host class note: this runner sits within 2.5% of the v1.5 Prism
baseline (fixtures/bench_baseline.json: 65.034 / 67.507 / 68.249),
so it is a consistent same-class host. Absolute ms are host-relative;
the v1.11 gate is the RELATIVE regression vs these numbers, not the
absolute floor. tolerance_pct below is the plan §8.2 hard gate (<2%).
